email_body:
Dear Embrace the Earth Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Social Media and Content Officer volunteer/internship position. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, SEO, and social media, I am eager to contribute to your mission of protecting nature and tackling climate change.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, which has honed my skills in producing engaging digital content. My project mirook.com involved building a website from scratch, implementing social media integration, and optimizing for search engines—experience directly relevant to your needs. I am proficient in Canva and have basic video editing skills, and I am passionate about using digital storytelling to inspire environmental action.

I am available to commit 2 hours daily from Monday to Friday and am interested in a long-term volunteer role. This position aligns perfectly with my career goals in environmental communication, and I am excited about the opportunity to grow my portfolio while supporting your impactful work.

Please find attached my CV and portfolio. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Warm regards,
